text:
sam_eng: heads-up from a bring-up run: atlas-13B int4 prefill to 12k ctx shows occasional kv_index reorders around shard boundaries and small token hallucinations after ~11.8k. attaching quick notes.

ema_ml: can you drop the exact run command + envs?

sam_eng: ran: `./bench_prefill --model atlas-13b --quant int4 --ctx 12288 --prefill tests/long_seed_12k.txt --rope_scale 0.9 --shard-count 4`

jin: int4 + rope_scale != 1.0 is a prime suspect. did you also try int8 or fp32?

sam_eng: fp32 looks clean. int8 reduces but still a few misorders. int4 has the worst signal.

mira: what do you mean by misorders? any logs?

sam_eng: kv debug snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:01Z] kv_index: shard=1 slot=11887 -> idx=11886 hash=0x1a2b
[2026-03-20T09:12:01Z] kv_index: shard=1 slot=11888 -> idx=11888 hash=0x1a2c
[2026-03-20T09:12:01Z] kv_index: shard=1 slot=11889 -> idx=11887 hash=0x1a2d
```
sequence jumps 11886,11888,11887. also saw prefetched kv keys map to attention rows off by 1 occasionally.

ema_ml: could be a compact/evict race or the indexer using non-atomic increments under quant path. any concurrent GC or compaction running?

sam_eng: compaction triggered at same time (we were at 90% fill for the shard). the scheduler says compaction paused but not fully gated.

jin: two orthogonal issues: 1) numeric quantization changes key ordering due to tiny changes in hash inputs if rotary scaling differs; 2) concurrency with compaction. we should test both in isolation.

mira: quick repro idea: deterministic prefill that crosses the shard boundary exactly at the compaction threshold, with a synthetic deterministic RNG so we can assert exact kv_index sequence. include a compile-time rope_scale metadata blob and check runtime env mismatch.

sam_eng: created a small test harness `tests/repro_kv_jitter.py` that uses deterministic token ids and forces compaction at slot 11888. i'll push.

ops-bot: CI job queued: atlas-prefill-repro-612987 queued (job 99012).

ema_ml: also, please add an explicit runtime check: compare compiled_rope_hash vs runtime_rope_hash on startup and fail fast with clear error explaining mismatch and migration steps.

jin: and for quant paths, add a short fuzz that injects tiny floating-point perturbations before hashing to ensure ordering stable across quantization. might catch cases where quantization changes hash collisions.

mira: i've seen hash changes when we apply per-token scaling before hashing for rotary. unify the hashing input (use pre-rotary coords) for indexing to keep index invariant under rope scaling.

sam_eng: good point. that would separate coordinate transforms from index keys. will try changing index key derivation to use token-pos integer + head id rather than post-rope vectors.

ema_ml: besides code fixes, schedule a nightly bisect over quant codepaths (int8,int4) across compaction toggles and rope_scale variants. save failing seeds to the regression corpus.

ops-bot: nightly-bisect scheduled: quant-kv-bisect starting 2026-03-21 03:30 UTC job 99013.

jin: one more: add a small telemetry event when kv_index reorder detected (sampled) with shard, slot range, quant mode, and rope metadata. helps track in-prod occurrences. keep PII-free.

mira: ack. i'll add telemetry and a runbook blurb.

sam_eng: pushing two PRs: 1) runtime rope metadata assertion + error text (WIP), 2) kv key derivation change + deterministic test harness. linking in thread when done.

ema_ml: i'll own the nightly regression automation and add the deterministic seeds to the eval repo.

sam_eng: updated run after changing key derivation: int4 run with forced compaction passed the deterministic test. posting CI: http://ci.internal/99014. leaving thread open until telemetry + PRs merged. :metal:
